# Containers & Layouts gets its accordion, wizard and fragment tiles

## Context

#21140's target gives Containers & Layouts two cards and four tiles. On `dev` `78013b10fc` the cards are there (the layouts side by side, the cube) and one tile (the form layout). Three tiles are missing: the accordion, the card layout and the fragment. Their folders were last changed in 2024, 2025 and January 2026, and none has a record. No leaf was filed.

## The Problem

The band's read of the three ([its rows](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6980130976)):

- `container/accordion`: "lorem ipsum, header icons drawn as a black square against the text, and the inspector lists its configs as text, not controls."
- `layout/card`: "slides between a red, a green and a blue rectangle."
- `container/fragment`: "the only demo of fragments (children grouped without a wrapper element), but nothing on screen shows that the DOM stays flat; dark only; at 390 the labels are cut."

Three containers every app uses are invisible in the group that is about them.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/container/Accordion.mjs` (`maxExpandedItems`), `src/layout/Card.mjs` (the slide direction), `src/container/Fragment.mjs`.
- The band's correction: the fragment example has no inspector, so it moves onto the workbench to become a tile.
- A tile is a record with `kind: 'component'` that opens on the workbench.

## The Fix

Renew the three in place and publish them as tiles, in one pull request. The accordion gets real content and a live `maxExpandedItems` control. The card layout becomes a three-step wizard and keeps its slide-direction control. The fragment moves onto the workbench and shows its DOM beside it, so a visitor sees that no wrapper element exists.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The accordion's icons draw, its inspector offers `maxExpandedItems` as a control, and the control changes the stage.
- [ ] The wizard moves forward and back by button and by keyboard, and the slide direction can be changed.
- [ ] The fragment's stage shows the flat DOM beside the component, in every theme, with no label cut at 390×844.
- [ ] No console error, at 1440×900 and at 390×844.
- [ ] Three records with family `layouts` and `kind: 'component'`, each with a crop cover (through `neomjs/pages`).
- [ ] The look: one frame per tile's stage at both sizes, Neo Dark, on the pull request, read cold by the reviewer's seat.

**Publication (added 22 Nov, the same for every leaf of this wave).** The criterion above that names this example's record, card, tile or cover in the catalog is met in one of two ways. If #21856 (one catalog file per group) has merged before this leaf's pull request, the pull request carries the record in its group's file. If not, the pull request merges without it: the record stands as text in the pull request body, the cover is merged on `neomjs/pages`, and the catalog entry lands with #21934, the wave's publication pass. Either way this leaf closes with its example.

## Out of Scope

Records for `container/base`, `panel` and `viewport` (developer checks, they leave the catalog). The two cards.
